title: Work in a Changing World
text:
Many young people today believe that their future careers will look very different from those of their parents. Traditional jobs for life have become rare, and workers often change employers several times. As a result, the ability to learn new skills quickly is now considered essential by many employers.

Experts predict that automation will remove some routine tasks, but it will also create new roles in areas such as data analysis and renewable energy. For this reason, many universities now encourage students to combine technical knowledge with communication and problem-solving skills. Those who adapt early are likely to find the job market more welcoming.

questions.text: According to paragraph one, what do many employers consider essential?
options: The ability to learn new skills quickly
A degree from a famous university

questions.text: According to paragraph two, in which new areas will roles be created?
What can be inferred about workers who stay with one employer for their whole career?
options: They are likely to be rare in the modern job market
They always earn the highest salaries
Universities prefer them to all other graduates
They have no need to learn new skills

questions.text: What does the author suggest about students who adapt early?
options: They will probably have better job prospects
They will be forced to change careers
They will stop studying technical subjects

vocabulary.definition: not common or not often seen
the use of machines or computers to do work that people did before
to change in order to deal successfully with a new situation

paragraph_translations: Багато молодих людей сьогодні вважають, що їхня майбутня кар'єра буде виглядати зовсім інакше, ніж у їхніх батьків. Традиційні роботи на все життя стали рідкістю, а працівники часто змінюють роботодавців кілька разів. Тому здатність швидко опановувати нові навички зараз багато роботодавців вважають обов'язковою.

Експерти прогнозують, що автоматизація усуне деякі рутинні завдання, але також створить нові посади в таких сферах, як аналіз даних і відновлювана енергетика. З цієї причини багато університетів тепер заохочують студентів поєднувати технічні знання з навичками комунікації та розв'язання проблем. Ті, хто рано пристосовується, швидше знайдуть привітнішого ринку праці.
